Former Louisiana Mayor Completes Jail Term for Rape Conviction

Former DeRidder Mayor Misty Roberts has completed a 90-day jail sentence for the rape of a teenage boy. A judge acknowledged making a mistake in the sentencing but denied a request to amend the ruling. Roberts faced a potential sentence of up to 17 years in prison following her conviction. The incident involved a pool party.
